title: se-implementation-scratchpad-cobalt-finance
content:
Cobalt Finance - SE implementation scratchpad
Owner: Aisha Patel
Last sync: 2025-11-12 (internal prep for 11/13 call)

Context/goal:
- Migrate Cobalt's customer-facing chatbot from hosted vendor -> Redwood Private (VPC) deployment for PCI/financial data isolation.
- Target: 99.9% uptime, <150ms p50 latency for short prompts, 300 QPS burst capable.
- Initial workload: chat+embeddings for search/rerank, follow-on goal: assistant workflows (tooling).

High-level deliverables (MVP):
- VPC peering + firewall rules configured
- Private control plane on customer VPC, KMS integration for keys
- Dedicated model pool (reserved) with canary rollout policy
- Test harness + prompt/embedding smoke tests and monitoring dashboards

Immediate action items (short-term)
- [ ] Complete VPC CIDR and peer details from infra (Cobalt): ask for full list of subnets + NAT details (TODO: Marco)
- [ ] Confirm KMS provider: they mentioned AWS KMS but legal asked about HSM — Evelyn to check contract
- [x] Create initial Redwood tenant for Cobalt (tenant: cobalt-prod) — done 2025-11-04
- [ ] Provision dedicated GPU pool sizing estimate (3x A10G equiv for initial 50 QPS) — infra ask (Jonah)
- [ ] Create firewall rule template (allowed ports: 443, 8443 for control plane) and send to Cobalt network ops
- [ ] Define model variants to serve: rt-large-v1 (quantized) for cost, rt-large-v1-accuracy for canary
- [ ] Determine rate limit config and burst policy (default: 200 RPS, burst 500) pending product sign-off

Config notes / snippets to use in onboarding docs:
- Tenant: cobalt-prod
- Env tags: environment=prod, customer=cobalt-finance, region=us-east-1
- Example routing policy (will be created as policy 'cobalt-routing-default'):
  - primary: rt-large-v1 (quantized)
  - fallback: rt-large-v1-accuracy
  - locality: prefer region us-east-1, fallback us-west-2

- KMS integration (AWS) - quick checklist:
  - Customer to provide KMS ARN for key used to encrypt model cache
  - Confirm IAM role for Redwood control plane: role/redwood-kms-access with kms:Decrypt,Encrypt,GenerateDataKey
  - Verify key policy allows cross-account usage from our control-plane account

Network specifics to collect from customer (ask during 11/13 call):
- VPC ID(s) and subnets for private endpoints (public/private)
- CIDR blocks for peering
- Egress NAT behavior for async requests (do they use proxy?)
- Any IP allowlist requirements for on-prem connectors

Test prompts / eval checks (smoke):
- Chat (short): "What's my transaction balance for last week?" (should return non-sensitive stub + link to portal)
- Embeddings: index 1000 sample transactions, query similarity top-k returns baseline 0.65+ precision
- Latency: p50 <150ms for 128-token response simulated at 50QPS
- Token cost estimate: ~0.0008 USD/token for quantized path (estimate, confirm)

Example curl (auth placeholder):
curl -X POST https://private-us-east-1.redwood.example/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rt-large-v1","input":"hello"}'

Env vars (for SE quick deploy on customer staging):
- REDWOOD_TENANT=cobalt-prod
- REDWOOD_REGION=us-east-1
- REDWOOD_API_KEY=<ephemeral-from-console>

Monitoring / SLOs / Alerts:
- Dashboard: per-tenant token usage, per-model latency, batch size distribution
- Alerts: p95 latency > 500ms for 10m -> pager, error rate >1% for 5m -> slack #se-alerts
- Cost burn alert: 3-day spend > projected commit -> ops notif

Rollout plan (canary):
- Phase 1 (internal): deploy model variant to 10% of traffic (only internal test accounts) for 24h
- Phase 2 (soft): 25% external traffic (low-risk routes) for 48h, watch quality/regression on eval prompts
- Phase 3: 100% if metrics stable for 72h
- Rollback plan: automated rollback to fallback variant if p95 latency increases >2x or quality drop >5% on eval set

Questions / open items for next call with Cobalt (11/13)
- KMS: HSM requirement or AWS KMS acceptable? (Evelyn)
- Data scope: Do we need to sign a new DPA for embeddings retention? They asked about 30-day retention and auto-delete - what policy?
- Payment model: will they commit to Dedicated reserved capacity or start on Private pay-as-you-go? (sales)
- SSO / IAM: SAML metadata for their IdP for console access?

Meeting notes (internal prep):
- John Park (Cobalt - Head of Platform) will join 11/13; main ask: PCI scoping and timeline
- They want minimal downtime migration window (weekend) and a rehearsed rollback plan
- They have an internal compliance kickoff next week -> likely ask for SOC2 + PCI artifacts

Quick links to use in customer email:
- Onboarding checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Onboarding+Checklist
- Contact: se-oncall@redwood.ai, infra-priv-deploy@redwood.ai

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep prompts for eval close to their real queries (finance phrasing). Avoid using real PII samples in docs.
- After KMS confirmation, add key policy snippet to Confluence page.
- Prepare short demo that shows canary rollback within console (screen recording).

Last edits: added explicit routing policy + tests 2025-11-12 by Aisha
